totals.note: drugs/diseases are distinct MeSH identifiers; avg_path_length is mean edges (links) per path.

layers.name: evidence
layers.note: ai_curated only; runs on records with per-edge evidence. 0 committed record(s) carry evidence, so Layer 4 is a no-op here.

provenance.note: Legacy vs AI-curated split computed from per-edge evidence presence. Per-record model/prompt-version/run-id/date is not captured on records yet, so by_model / by_month cannot be computed.

indication_coverage.note: Coverage vs an external approved-indication list (e.g. DrugCentral) is not computed: the external denominator is not in-repo. Only the corpus-side counts (distinct indications/drugs/diseases already having a path) are known.

path_length_distribution.note: length = number of edges (links) per path; convention target is 3-7.

structural_quality.note: Deterministic structural scorer (scripts/quality/structural_quality.py). record_count = records with >=1 flag of that code.
